other_exits: Signal-based close: long position closed when DnValue > UpValue (sell signal appears) if BuyPosClose is enabled; short position closed when UpValue > DnValue (buy signal appears) if SellPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative values = fixed lot size (abs value), positive values = share of deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses crossover on bar [1] vs bar [0] of UltraWPR buffers: long when UpValue[1]>DnValue[1] AND UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0] (crossover just happened on previous bar pair). Signal bar index is configurable (SignalBar param, default=1). TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles position checking, margin verification, and actual order placement - its internal logic is opaque from this source. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime is set to last bar date + timeframe seconds, likely used as a trade validity window by TradeAlgorithms.mqh. GlobalVariableDel_ on deinit suggests the trade algorithms use global variables for state tracking.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of UltraWPR custom indicator (WPR with variable-period smoothing using JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA methods from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh). TradeAlgorithms.mqh must be reverse-engineered or replaced - it encapsulates position management, money management (negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit fraction), margin checks, and order execution with deviation. The crossover logic itself is straightforward: compare two buffers at SignalBar and SignalBar+1 positions. Position sizing conditional logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit share) must be preserved. SL/TP are in points not pips - need point/pip normalization for Python.
